literal: Suffering joy as if one takes, will come to be one's foes desiring greatness.
translation: If one embraces adversity as joy, one will attain a greatness that even one's enemies admire.
modern: துன்பத்தையே இன்பமாக ஏற்றுக்கொண்டால், ஒருவனுக்கு அவனுடைய பகைவரும் விரும்பும் பெருமை உண்டாகும்.
explanation: This couplet teaches the mindset needed to overcome adversity. By choosing to view suffering ('இன்னாமை') as a form of joy ('இன்பம்'), a person demonstrates extraordinary resilience. Such an unshakable attitude elevates their character to a level of greatness ('சிறப்பு') that commands respect and admiration even from their enemies ('ஒன்னார்'). The word 'விழையும்' highlights that this greatness is so compelling that foes themselves wish they possessed it.
